lss.config.receive_server_lods.tooltip: Download distant terrain from this server. Turn off to stop all LOD downloads.
lss.config.lod_distance.tooltip: How far distant terrain loads, in chunks. 0 uses the server's distance.
lss.config.column_rate_limit.tooltip: Caps how fast LODs download. Lower it if loading distant terrain stutters your game or slows your connection. 0 means unlimited.
lss.config.join_slow_start.tooltip: Start gently after joining, then increase the download rate. Applies to native LSS and DH. Turn off to use the full rate immediately.
lss.config.join_slow_start.tooltip.gover: Starts downloads gently on LSS or DH. Has no effect while adaptive transfer rate is off.
lss.config.map_ingestion.tooltip: Save downloaded distant terrain into your installed map mod (Xaero's World Map 1.42.0+ or JourneyMap 6.0.0+), so the map fills in far beyond your render distance. Downloads are paced to the map's writing speed so it stays complete; map data can use a lot of disk at large LOD distances. After Apply, reconnect to activate. Disabling stops future writes; it does not erase existing map data.
lss.config.map_ingestion.tooltip.not_ins: Save downloaded distant terrain into a supported map mod (Xaero's World Map 1.42.0+ or JourneyMap 6.0.0+). Has no effect right now: no supported map mod is installed.
lss.config.far_players_enabled.tooltip: See other players far beyond your normal render distance, drawn as simple models in the distant terrain. The server must have far players enabled.
lss.config.far_players_share_self.toolti: Allow other players to see your distant model through this feature. Apply saves and activates this preference. Normal Minecraft tracking is independent.
lss.config.far_players_name_tags.tooltip: Show name tags over far player models, and over players still in normal range once they are past the game's own 64-block tag distance. Drawn by this mod, so other mods' name tag settings do not apply to them.
lss.config.far_players_full_bright.toolt: Draw far players at full brightness so they stand out at night. Off keeps them lit like the distant terrain around them.
lss.config.far_players_render_distance.t: How far away, in blocks, far players are still drawn. 0 follows the server's limit. Also caps this mod's name tags.
Draw far players past the game's normal draw limit, out to the farthest far player. Only visible with an LOD mod such as Voxy. Fog can still hide very distant players; if they fade out, turn off fog in your LOD mod. Not used while a shader pack is on.
lss.config.redownload_terrain.tooltip: Use this if distant terrain looks wrong or has gaps. It clears the download records so the server sends the terrain again. Terrain your LOD mod has already saved is not deleted.
lss.redownload.title: Re-download distant terrain?
lss.redownload.this_server: This server's distant terrain will be downloaded again. That can take a while and uses bandwidth.
lss.redownload.all_servers: You are not connected to a server that sends distant terrain, so this clears the download records for every server. Each server sends its distant terrain again the next time you join it, which can take a while and uses bandwidth.
lss.redownload.not_receiving: Distant terrain is not being downloaded from this server right now, so nothing can be cleared. Try again once it is downloading.
lss.redownload.saved_terrain: Terrain your LOD mod has already saved is not deleted. To delete saved terrain, use /%s reset.
lss.redownload.toast.this_server: This server will send its distant terrain again.
lss.redownload.toast.all_servers: Download records cleared for every server.
lss.redownload.failed: The download records could not be cleared. Details are in the game log.
lss.status.title: LOD status
lss.settings.reload_failed: Settings unchanged. Reload could not complete; check the game log and try again.
lss.settings.pending_reconnect_notice: Some accepted settings are waiting for reconnect.
lss.settings.privacy_sent: Sharing preference sent to the server.
lss.settings.privacy_no_channel: Share My Position: saved, but no server has received it yet. Until one does, a server uses its own default, which may show your position.
lss.settings.privacy_pending: Sharing preference not sent yet; retrying on this connection.
lss.far_players.sharing_required: This server requires position sharing: other players can see where you are from far away, and your Share My Position setting does not apply here.
lss.far_players.permission_no_longer_hid: You have the lss.farplayers.hidden permission. Since 0.21.0 it no longer hides you from far players by itself: turn off Share My Position to hide. Server owners: set far_players.hide_permission_holders in the server config (true hides holders as before, false keeps this) to stop this message.
lss.settings.conflict_detail: The YAML file changed or could not be read. Your edits are retained. "Save my changes anyway" rereads the file and applies only your selected edits to it. Discard keeps the disk file. Nothing has been activated.
lss.settings.failure_detail: The save failed. Your edits are retained even if Sodium shows no changes. Retry without re-entering values, keep the draft for later, or discard it. Live settings are unchanged.
lss.settings.inactive: Settings are inactive. Repair the settings file and restart the client; details are in the game log.
lss.status.reception: Receiving distant terrain: %s; a mod to show it: %s
lss.status.far_players: Far players sent by this server: %s
lss.status.conditions: Observed conditions (a queue alone does not prove a bottleneck): %s
lss.status.progress: Progress in this world: %s columns, %s bytes; distance %s/%s chunks
lss.status.rate: Rate gate events in this sample: %s; active manual cap %s columns/s (0 unlimited; adaptive cap may also bind)
lss.status.queues: Queues: decode=%s, ingest=%s, Xaero rebuild=%s, JourneyMap=%s
lss.status.remote_unknown: Remote limiting cause: unknown; ask an operator for server diagnostics.
lss.status.settings.saved: Last read/saved: receive %s, distance %s chunks, rate %s columns/s, maps %s, sharing %s
lss.status.settings.configured: Accepted by reload: receive %s, distance %s chunks, rate %s columns/s, maps %s, sharing %s
lss.status.settings.effective: Active: receive %s, distance %s chunks, rate %s columns/s, maps %s, sharing %s
lss.status.reason.map_ingestion_server_b: map saving turned off by this server
lss.settings.adoption_pending: Settings accepted; subsystem activation is still pending. Run the client reload command again to retry.
lss.settings.adoption_failed: Settings accepted, but subsystem activation failed. Check the log and run the client reload command again to retry.
lss.settings.normalized: Normalized %s: requested %s; effective %s. YAML was left unchanged.
lss.status.export_waiting: Waiting for a current-session snapshot; retry after the next tick.
lss.status.export_busy: Diagnostics exporter busy; retry after the current export.
lss.status.export_failed: Diagnostics export failed; check directory permissions and free space.
lss.settings.error_logged: Technical details are recorded in the game log.
lss.config.lod_source.tooltip: Lets Voxy show terrain from servers running Distant Horizons that have no LSS. Native LSS always wins. Requires Voxy; do not use with the Distant Horizons client mod. Applies on reconnect (NeoForge: restart the game). DH terrain is a block-resolution approximation and may overwrite saved Voxy terrain.
lss.config.map_ingestion.tooltip.native_: Writes native LSS terrain into installed map mods. DH terrain goes to Voxy only; this option has no effect while using DH.
lss.config.map_ingestion.tooltip.server_: Turned off by this server: it asks clients not to save its distant terrain into map mods. Voxy, if installed, still renders that terrain, and your setting is kept for other servers.
lss.status.dh.terrain: Terrain: DH approximation at block resolution
lss.status.dh.columns: Chunk columns: enqueued %s, vanilla skipped %s, failed %s
lss.status.dh.resources: Resources: wire %s, owned %s bytes; decode %s, requests %s, Voxy backlog %s
lss.status.dh.limits: Limits: %s chunks; generation %s, sync %s requests/s; bandwidth %s KB/s
lss.status.dh.receipts: Receipts: stored %s, restored this session %s; pressure-dropped terrain frames %s
lss.status.dh.freshness: Freshness: sync on load %s (%s), live updates %s (%s), applied/deferred %s/%s, last reply %s
lss.status.dh.state.between_sessions: waiting for the next DH session
lss.status.dh.state.no_service: no DH service on this server
lss.status.dh.state.blocked: stopped for this connection; reconnect to resume
lss.status.dh.state.stopped: stopped; see the reason. To restart it, reconnect or turn Receive Server LODs off and on
lss.status.dh.reason.native_offer: the server offers native LOD service, which takes precedence
lss.status.dh.reason.client_mod_conflict: the Distant Horizons client mod is installed; remove it to use DH server terrain through Voxy
lss.status.dh.reason.restart_required: restart the game to register the DH channel
lss.status.dh.reason.no_dh_channel: the server does not advertise Distant Horizons
lss.status.dh.reason.no_dh_reply: the server's DH channel did not answer protocol 16; it may run DH 3.2.x or have DH networking disabled
lss.status.dh.reason.old_dh_protocol: the server runs an older DH protocol; ask the admin to update to DH 3.3.x
lss.status.dh.reason.vanilla_limit: vanilla chunk tracking limit reached; reconnect to resume
lss.status.dh.reason.dimension_limit: too many dimensions on this connection; reconnect to resume
lss.status.dh.reason.source_stopped: stopped after an error; see the log
lss.status.dh.reason.sync_disabled_local: sync on load is off in the client settings
lss.status.dh.reason.receipts_unavailabl: saved receipts unavailable; terrain is downloaded again
lss.status.dh.reason.receipts_unverified: Voxy readback unavailable; saved receipts are trusted without checking
lss.status.dh.activity.idle: idle; terrain in range is current
lss.status.dh.notice.stopped: Distant Horizons terrain stopped: %s. Run /%s diag for details.
lss.status.verdict.working: Working: receiving distant terrain from this server.
lss.status.verdict.working_dh: Working: receiving distant terrain from this server's Distant Horizons.
lss.status.verdict.waiting: Not ready yet: distant terrain is still being set up for this server.
lss.status.verdict.local_world: This is your own world, so there is nothing to download.
lss.status.verdict.no_support: Not working: this server doesn't seem to have this mod installed, so there is nothing for it to show here.
lss.status.verdict.no_answer: Not working: this server has this mod but hasn't answered. The mod versions or the Minecraft versions probably don't match; a very slow connection can also cause this.
lss.status.verdict.version_mismatch: Not working: this server runs a different version of this mod. Update whichever is older.
lss.status.verdict.server_outdated: Not working: this server runs an older version of this mod. Only the server can update it.
lss.status.verdict.client_outdated: Not working: your version of this mod is too old for this server. Update the mod.
lss.status.verdict.server_off: Not working: the server has distant terrain switched off here: for everyone, for this world, or for you.
lss.status.verdict.nothing_to_show: Not working: nothing here can show distant terrain. Add an LOD mod such as Voxy, or a map mod such as Xaero's World Map or JourneyMap.
lss.status.verdict.renderer_not_connecte: Not working with Voxy: this mod could not connect to your Voxy. Update both mods.
lss.status.verdict.map_writing_off: Off: "Map Ingestion" is turned off in this mod's settings, and nothing else here can show distant terrain.
lss.status.verdict.map_not_connected: Not working: this mod could not connect to your map mod, and nothing else here can show distant terrain. Update both mods.
lss.status.verdict.maps_blocked: Not working: this server asks that distant terrain is not added to maps, and you have no LOD mod such as Voxy to show it.
lss.status.verdict.receiving_off: Off: you turned receiving off in the settings.
lss.status.verdict.source_not_running: Not working: the Distant Horizons source is not running. The lines below say why.
lss.status.discovery.no_channel: the server does not offer it
lss.notice.no_support: This server doesn't seem to have this mod installed, so there is nothing for it to show here. Nothing is wrong with your game.
lss.notice.nothing_to_show: This mod only downloads distant terrain. To see it, add an LOD mod such as Voxy, or a map mod such as Xaero's World Map or JourneyMap.
lss.notice.renderer_not_connected: This mod could not connect to your Voxy, so Voxy can't show distant terrain. Updating both mods usually fixes it.
lss.notice.map_not_connected: This mod could not connect to your map mod, so distant terrain can't be shown. Updating both mods usually fixes it.
lss.notice.version_mismatch: This server runs a different version of this mod, so you get no distant terrain. Update whichever is older.
lss.notice.server_outdated: This server runs an older version of this mod, so you get no distant terrain. Only the server can update it.
lss.notice.client_outdated: Your version of this mod is too old for this server, so you get no distant terrain. Update the mod to fix it.
lss.notice.server_off: The server has distant terrain switched off here: for everyone, for this world, or for you. Nothing is wrong with your game.
